item.title: Dan Kelly joins Pence's Advancing American Freedom as fellow
item.description: Dan Kelly, a Wisconsin Supreme Court justice from 2016 to 2020 appointed by Gov. Scott Walker, has joined Advancing American Freedom.

item.title: Nebraska's State Capitol: A Grand Structure
item.description: Though its football glory may have faded, Nebraska's capitol in Lincoln ranks among America's greatest buildings.

item.title: Trump suggests removing White House press from briefing room
item.description: President Trump indicated he might remove White House reporters from the press briefing room at 1600 Pennsylvania Ave.

item.title: Newsom's covert fracking ban is overturned
item.description: California's governor attempted to ban oil production by executive action. A state judge has revealed the deception.
